tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen (Adobe Spectrum's dark background-base). Neutral, untinted gray so the user's colors aren't shifted.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the video or photo preview inside both editors, as in CapCut, so the frame edges read clearly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom navigation, tool bar, timeline lanes (Spectrum layer-1).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised controls on surface: secondary buttons, chips, search field, unselected font tiles, pressed segments, empty media frames. It never marks a selected state (only 1.4:1 against canvas): selection is white.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and quiet borders. Decorative only: never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons (about 95% white, softer than pure white on near-black). 12.4:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and inactive icons. 5.7:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders, timecodes and ruler labels. 4.6:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Memix sky blue: CapCut's cyan moved 9° toward Spectrum blue. The one primary action per screen (Create, Export, Apply), the active tool, links, progress, and everything that is a meme sound. Text on it is on-primary (7.9:1).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills. Text on it is on-primary (6.0:1).

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: 16% sky wash behind the active tool, sound play buttons and the "Add a meme sound" pill (over a canvas base). Icons and text on it use primary (6.2:1 over canvas). It never fills a whole row: a playing sound row steps one value up instead (surface on canvas, surface-raised on surface). Pressed, these fills turn surface-raised (primary on it 5.9:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-pressed, selection-white fills and danger. Also the 1px dark edge beside white selection marks drawn over the user's content (the text frame, its handle and snap guides on the preview, P1-10), so they read on any video: white plus this edge is at least 4.3:1 against any color.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected clip or layer outline, trim handles, playhead, selected chip, segment and font tile fills (text on them on-primary), the selected swatch ring: white, as in CapCut, so selection never competes with clip colors.

tokens.name: track-video
tokens.usage: Main video and overlay clips (they show thumbnails). Labels on it are text.

tokens.name: track-text
tokens.usage: Text clips on the timeline and text layers in the layers panel. Labels on it are on-track (7.5:1).

tokens.name: track-sticker
tokens.usage: Sticker, image and cut-out clips. Labels on it are on-track (9.0:1).

tokens.name: track-meme-sound
tokens.usage: Meme sound clips: the brand color, same as primary, so sound is always Memix blue. Labels on it are on-track (7.9:1).

tokens.name: track-audio
tokens.usage: Original audio, imported audio and voiceover clips: green, the editing convention for audio. Labels on it are on-track (6.8:1).

tokens.name: track-effect
tokens.usage: Effect and filter clips. Labels on it are on-track (6.5:1).

tokens.name: on-track
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on every colored track fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, discard and recording states, always with a word or icon. Text on it is on-primary (5.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of danger fills. Text on it is on-primary (4.8:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Export finished and saved states, always with a word or icon. Text on it is on-primary (9.3:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px outside the control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs. On the timeline: the wash over the part of an item past the end of the video (its label switches to text), and the selected main clip's duration badge (text on it is 7.5:1 or more over any thumbnail).

fonts.note: Hindi display face (P1-17) and the Devanagari partner of Anton in captions (P1-10). Alternative: the variable https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/teko/Teko%5Bwght%5D.ttf (285 KB, weights 300 to 700), only if Compose Multiplatform resources can set its weight axis on Android and iOS.
Caption font 'Modern' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.
Caption font 'Bubbly' (P1-10). Ek Type; Latin, Latin Ext, Vietnamese, Devanagari. Static build from the upstream that google/fonts names (its own file is the 667 KB variable Baloo2[wght].ttf).
Caption font 'Handwritten' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.
Caption font 'Serif' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, Google Fonts (SIL OFL). Meme captions, the wordmark and the Home hero only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero and empty-state headlines, uppercase.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Entry cards and sheet heroes, uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Memix name (Home top bar, until a logo exists). Always Anton, in every language: unlike display, it never switches to the Hindi face. Written as is, not uppercased.

styles.name: meme-caption
styles.usage: Default caption style in both editors: white fill with a 3px black outline stroke (the classic meme look; this is the user's content, not chrome).

groups.name: Display (Hindi)
groups.note: Teko Bold, Indian Type Foundry (SIL OFL 1.1): Latin, Latin Extended and Devanagari. Replaces the Display group's display-xl and display when the app language is Hindi (P1-17), for the whole string, Latin letters included. The Memix wordmark stays Anton. Letter spacing 0, because tracking breaks the Devanagari headline bar.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hindi: Home hero and empty-state headlines. The line height is Teko's own line spacing (1.433 em; the candrabindu and the vocalic-rr sign reach its full ascent and descent), rounded up to the 4px grid, so no mark above the headline bar or below the baseline is cut (P1-17 build, 9 Oct 2026).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hindi: entry cards and sheet heroes. Line height from Teko's own line spacing, as display-xl.

groups.name: Caption sample
groups.note: Set in the caption font it previews (caption.fonts), at that file's own weight. The only interface text not in Space Grotesk, Space Mono or the display faces, because the sample is the choice.

styles.name: caption-sample
styles.usage: The name on each FontTile in the Style panel (P1-10), drawn in that font. Line height 28 leaves room for Devanagari marks above and below in every caption font.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Space Grotesk, Google Fonts (SIL OFL). Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a clip, drop a sound, share it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tool bar labels, metadata, timeline clip labels.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Playback timecode, ruler marks, durations in the editors.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screen side gutter is space-4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gaps between clips on a track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above screen titles, large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: Chunky, never sharp; pills for chips and tabs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline clips, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the Create button, tool highlights.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, template thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented tabs, play buttons.

shadow.note: No hard or decorative shadows: surfaces separate by value steps (canvas → surface → surface-raised), as in CapCut and Spectrum. Only sheets and floating menus cast a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets lifting over a screen.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating menus and toasts.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and quiet borders, with the hairline color.

tokens.name: stroke-selection
tokens.usage: Selected clip or layer outline, with the selection color.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.

size.note: Fixed sizes used across screens (dp on Android).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size for every control.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Editor tool bar.

tokens.name: tool-item-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of one tool in the editors' tool bars (icon over a caption label, at least touch-target tall). A tool widens only when one word of its label can't fit at large font sizes. About five and a half tools show at 360 wide, so the first tools never need a scroll (P1-06).

tokens.name: track-height-video
tokens.usage: Main video track clips.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: Every other track's clips.

tokens.name: playhead-width
tokens.usage: Timeline playhead line, in selection white.

tokens.name: playhead-head-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the round head on top of the timeline playhead, in selection white, centered on the line at the top of the ruler.

tokens.name: trim-handle-width
tokens.usage: Width of the white trim handles at both ends of the selected timeline item, just outside its selection outline. The touch target around each handle is still touch-target wide.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: Icons inside timeline items and badges, where a 24px icon doesn't fit (for example the lock on a locked item). The same drawings as the 24px set, scaled down; never for standalone controls.

tokens.name: rail-height
tokens.usage: The thin rail under a fill: progress bar and slider. Rail in hairline, fill in primary. Called rail, not track, because a track is a timeline lane in Memix.

tokens.name: canvas-handle-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the white scale-and-rotate handle on a selected text (later stickers and layers) on the preview, with a 1px on-primary edge and an icon-small icon in on-primary. Its touch target is still touch-target (P1-10).

tokens.name: swatch-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of a color swatch (text and outline colors, later brush colors). Drawn inside a touch-target square; the selected ring sits 2px outside it (P1-10).

tokens.name: list-thumb-size
tokens.usage: Square thumbnail at the start of a list row (a draft's first frame, P1-14), radius-sm, with the type badge in its corner. The row is at least this plus space-2 above and below.

tokens.name: badge-size
tokens.usage: Side of a square icon badge drawn over the user's picture (the type badge on a draft's thumbnail, P1-14): a scrim chip in radius-sm with an icon-small icon centered, so the 16px icon has 2px around it (its drawing already keeps 1.3px of air inside the 16px box). Placed space-1 from the picture's corner. Not for text badges, which size to their text.

tokens.name: play-disc-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the big play button centered on a video that isn't playing (the Exported screen, P1-12): a radius-full disc in primary with a 24px play icon in on-primary (7.9:1). It only draws; the tap belongs to the whole video, so the target is far above touch-target. Not for icon controls: those are IconButtons.

tokens.name: layer-thumb-size
tokens.usage: Square thumbnail at the start of a LayerRow in the photo editor's Layers panel (P2-01), radius-sm, showing the layer's picture fitted inside (no checkerboard). The row is at least this plus space-2 above and below, 56px. Smaller than list-thumb-size (the Drafts row's 56px) because ten rows share a panel capped at 40% of the window.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Presses, toggles, nav item color changes, and the reduce-motion fade that replaces every movement.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets sliding in and out, tab content changes.

tokens.name: duration-screen
tokens.usage: Screen pushes and pops.

tokens.name: duration-bonk
tokens.usage: The bonk: content landing on the timeline scales 1 to 1.12 to 1 with a slight overshoot. The width grows by the same dp as the height (or 12% if that's less), so a long clip doesn't sweep over its neighbors. Only for placing content.

caption.note: User content, not chrome: how captions (TextItem, TextLayer) render in both editors and in export. Never read through MemixTheme; the engineer keeps these in one commonMain place shared by the engines and both editors. Values are part of every saved draft's look: changing one after P1 ships needs a schema bump and a compensating migration. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P1-10-text.md.

fonts.name: Classic
fonts.usage: The Impact meme look and the default. Devanagari characters are drawn in Teko Bold (whole clusters, never split); emoji and other scripts in the system font.

defaults.usage: A new text uses the last style picked in the current editor visit, otherwise these.

geometry.devanagariSizeFactorNote: Provisional. Size of Teko Bold's Devanagari runs inside a Classic (Anton) caption, relative to the caption's font size. Set at phase-end QA, before the Phase 1 gate, from the mixed-line screenshot: Anton cap height / Teko headline height, rounded to 0.05, or 1.0 if within 5% (P1-10 review).
geometry.usage: Laid out once in canvas pixels, then drawn scaled. Outline stroke = font size / 12, centered on the outline, drawn before the fill.

canvas.note: User content, not chrome: the video canvas's shape and what fills it, drawn alike in preview and export (P1-11). Never read through MemixTheme; kept in one commonMain place next to the caption constants. Values are part of every saved draft's look: changing one after P1 ships needs a schema bump and a compensating migration. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P1-11-canvas.md.

custom.usage: w:h reduced to lowest terms; size = w*k by h*k, where k is the even whole number nearest 1080 / min(w, h). Both sides even, the ratio exact. The long side may be at most 2.39 times the short side (X's accepted range).

defaults.usage: Every new video project (P1-01). Black bars are the meme look: the first caption slot lands on the bar above a landscape clip.

image.usage: P2-12, both editors: a picture the user picks from the gallery fills the canvas (cover, centered crop, no pan or zoom) at the bottom of the stack: behind Fit clips in the video editor, behind every layer in the photo editor. Full brightness, no blur or dimming. A picture whose file is missing draws black. Remove goes back to the editor's default color. Gaps and missing clips stay black, as for the colors and Blur. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P2-12-canvas-background-image.md.

background.usage: Color: fills the canvas behind fitted clips. Blur: a Fill-scaled copy of the playing clip, Gaussian sigma = 3% of the output's shorter side (32 px at 1080p), full brightness. Gaps and missing clips are always black.

layers.usage: On a ratio change, a layer that was fully inside the frame and now crosses an edge moves in until it is this margin inside; one too big shrinks first (not below caption.geometry.scaleMin). A layer that was partly outside keeps its center and size.

photo.note: User content, not chrome: how the photo editor's canvas and layers start, behave and draw, alike in the editor and in export (P2-01, P2-13). Never read through MemixTheme; kept in one commonMain place (a PhotoCatalog) next to CaptionCatalog and CanvasCatalog. Values are part of every saved draft's look: changing one after P2 ships needs a schema bump and a compensating migration. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P2-01-photo-editor-shell.md.

defaults.usage: A blank canvas (the Create sheet's blank row, shown from P2-03), and the background of every photo start. White shows the frame against the black stage, and square posts everywhere without a crop. A photo start takes the photo's own shape instead (photoShape).

photoShape.usage: The canvas of a picked photo: the photo's width / height as shown (EXIF turn applied); a preset ratio if within 1%; otherwise the custom ratio with the fewest terms (1 to 99 each) within 1% of it. A photo more extreme than 2.39:1 either way gets 31:13 or 13:31 and sits whole inside it. Canvas size follows canvas.ratios and canvas.custom (shorter side about 1080 px).

image.sizeAtScale1: fitted inside the canvas, centered; recomputed from the canvas shape at draw time
image.usage: An image layer at scale 1 is the picture scaled to the largest size that lies wholly inside the canvas. A picture within 1% of the canvas's shape covers it instead, so no sliver of background shows. Scale runs 10% to 500% of that size (text keeps caption.geometry.scaleMin and scaleMax: 25% to 500%).

layers.usage: Opacity 10% to 100%, default 100% (a layer at 0% would be invisible but selectable; Hide exists for that). A duplicate sits 3% of the shorter side right and down of its original. On a ratio change a layer that was fully inside moves in just far enough to touch the edge (margin 0 for images, 2% for text and stickers, shrinking first if too big); a layer placed partly outside keeps its center and scale. Images are decoded at the size they are drawn, never above their source or 4096 px on the long side. See canvas.layers for the video rule.

sticker.sizeAtScale1: longer side = 35% of the canvas's shorter side, shape kept, centered; recomputed from the canvas at draw time
sticker.usage: P2-03. A sticker layer is a picture with transparency, drawn small on the meme: at scale 1 its longer side is 35% of the canvas's shorter side (378 px on a 1080 canvas), not fitted inside the frame like a photo layer. No cover rule. Scale 10% to 500% of that size (3.5% to 175% of the shorter side). Fixed rules: changing one after the closed test (about 25 Jan 2027) needs a schema bump. P2-14 (picker) and P4-12 (video stickers) use the same rule. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P2-03-photo-text-and-stickers.md.

text.usage: P2-03. A new text layer lands centered, scale 100%, at the first free slot of top (0.25), bottom (0.75), middle (0.5); a slot is taken when a visible text layer's center is within 0.1 of it; all taken: the middle. It lands at the front of the stack and is selected. The caption look is caption.* (unchanged); a text keeps scale 25% to 500% (caption.geometry). On a ratio change a text fully inside moves in to the 2% margin, shrinking first (not below 25%) if too big. Opacity draws the whole caption as one group (no outline show-through).

formats.note: P2-02. Every size is in S, the canvas's shorter side (1080 px at 1x export, 2160 px at 2x), so a format scales exactly with the export size. Formats draw inside the canvas and never change its ratio or size. Draw order: background, format parts, layers. Fixed rules: changing one after the closed test (about 25 Jan 2027) needs a schema bump. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P2-02-meme-formats.md.

classic.style: last style used this visit, else caption.defaultStyle

captionBar.usage: A white bar across the top, full width, drawn under the layers. The picture area is the canvas below it. The bar slot ignores the last-style rule (white text on the white bar would vanish).

demotivational.usage: The whole canvas is painted black; a white frame is drawn inset 0.10 S on the left, right and top and ending 0.40 S above the bottom; the picture area is inside it, inset 0.02 S more. The poster hides the canvas background color or image.

panels.usage: 2 to 6 cells edge to edge except a gutter (and the same margin around), showing the canvas background. Cover-fitted photos, zoom 100% to 500%, always covering the cell. An empty cell draws the background in the render and the export. Layers draw above the cells. Grid = 3: one wide on top and two below; 4: 2x2; 5: two on top and three below; 6: two rows of three.

bubbles.usage: A bubble is a layer: the body grows around its words (60% of the caption size, wrapped at 55% of S, padding 0.45 em by 0.35 em); body and tail are one filled shape with one round-joined stroke. The tail tip is stored as an offset from the body's center in body widths and heights and stays within 2 of them. Speech: rounded rectangle; Round: ellipse; Thought: ellipse with a trail of three circles.

stage.usage: The photo editor's canvas frame is inset space-4 on the stage (the video editor uses space-2) so a full-bleed layer's handle lies whole on the stage. A panel is as tall as its content up to 40% of the window height, and the stage refits above it (200 ms scale).

watermark.note: User content, not chrome: the 'Memix' mark drawn into every free export (P1-13; owner, 8 Oct 2026: small text, top-left, 3% margin). Never read through MemixTheme, and never drawn in the editor preview; kept in one commonMain place next to the caption and canvas constants and drawn by the one text renderer as the top-most export overlay. Not saved in drafts, so changing a value needs no schema bump and affects only new exports. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P1-13-watermark.md.
watermark.usage: Font size 4% of the output's shorter side (43 px at 1080p); the glyphs' ink box starts 3% of the shorter side from the left and top edges (32 px at 1080p; two constants, so the owner's phase-end TikTok and Reels test can move only the top, about 0.13 for option B); white at 80% with a soft, unoffset black shadow at 50% (blur 15% of the font size) so it reads on bright footage without an outline. Above every layer, for the whole video. Not translated, not uppercased. Brand names have no WCAG contrast requirement (SC 1.4.3 logotype exception).
